notes.title: Hyper Empire Patch 1.03
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416270/f53b34da5472eb4e41ca2d66560be14a563138a9.png[/img]

Greetings Commanders!  Today we bring to you a lot of requested features and another round of post launch polish.  As always, thank you to everyone for your feedback.

[b]Patch Log:[/b]

Main Game:
[list]
[*] Added the ability to customize your win conditions in game setup after your first win
[*] Added a backup file of saved games and achievements, in case the original gets corrupted or deleted somehow
[*] Added a new "Ultimate" difficulty level
[*] Steam Cloud saving should now be enabled to sync your saves and achievements across platforms
[/list]

Starting Out:
[list]
[*] Added a Quick Start image to help new players understand how to play
[*] Updated the tutorial from still images to videos
[/list]

Carrier:
[list]
[*] Added lore descriptions to the carriers on mouse over on the main game screen and for enemy boss carriers
[/list]

Combat:
[list]
[*] The carrier should no longer be able to spawn under the UI elements
[*] The shields should no longer show when they drop to zero
[*] Improved the Shield Matrix visual effect in battle
[/list]

Balance Adjustments:
[list]
[*] Increased the damage for Ion weapons.  Increased the range and accuracy of Ripper Guns.  This should help the Pirates.
[*] Slightly increased the cost increase for Agriculture Station, Hanger and Outpost
[*] Increased the maximum number A.I. Industry buildings from 3 to 5
[*] Slightly increased the cost for Alliance, Outrigger and Heresy Empire abilities
[*] Heresy now need ship capacity to use their Drone conversion ability
[*] Slightly increased enemy damage and armor on Hard and Very Hard difficulties
[/list]

[b]Developer Thoughts:[/b]

We are now two weeks out from the exciting launch of the game.  The often requested feature of changing your win conditions is now here.  Go forth and face greater challenges.  Be aware that the option to play from Turn 70 to 80 really pushes some of the algorithms beyond what they were intended.  if it causes issues we may need to drop the 80 turn option and only allow a 70 turn max.  We will keep an eye on it.  But for now you have a lot more flexibility on how you are able to approach a game.  To align with longer game options the maximum number of several buildings was increased.

The ability to customize win conditions appears when starting a new game after your first victory.

Many of you have been asking for cross-platform support and cloud saves.  With today's patch this should also be enabled.  We also put in secondary backups of all save files in case something becomes corrupted.  This should address any achievement resetting issues people were experiencing.  And you should now be able to port your progress from one machine to another.

A new "Ultimate" difficulty is now an option.  This is only for the most dedicated players.  We will probably tweak the difficulty of Ultimate further as we get more game data.  Hard and Very Hard difficulties were tweaked slightly to be harder.  We will keep an eye on this.  

We have also tried to make learning how to play the game easier.  The slideshow tutorial has been completely replaced with new videos and a topic menu.  Also a Quick Start image has been put in for people that jumped in and had no idea where to look.

Some adjustments were made to several buildings and abilities based on game data.  Most notably the Heresy Empire abilities had their cost adjusted, and the Heresy can no longer use Drone conversion to build ships they don't have capacity for.  The Heresy Admiral is now useful again.  The Heresy had by far the highest win percentage and needed a few tweaks to keep it in line with the other factions.

[b]Looking Ahead:[/b]

We still have a lot planned going forward.  We are going to take another look at the trade routes.  We also have some updates to the map so that it is more than just a list of enemies.  We are also seeing what our budget is to add new factions to the game.

Please continue to share your ideas and feedback in the forums.  We are working hard to try and make this the best experience possible for everyone.



We hope you enjoy the changes.  Good luck in your future games!

Fair Weather Studios

notes.title: Hyper Empire Patch 1.02
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416270/9a699fc39f0e2994f210028c4771b06f578a70d4.png[/img]

[b]Main Menu:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added the ability to save your current game when you quit, and to Continue your game from the main menu.  Take a break.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Battleship was unlocked instead of the Destroyer for a Normal Federation win
[/list]

[b]Achievements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where sometimes the increased data income earned through achievements 81-85 were not showing
[*] Fixed Achievements 136-140 were not properly spawning
[/list]

[b]Empire:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added the rest of the animations for the Empire powers.
[*] Updated the Conversion values for the Heresy
[*] Updated the faith costs for the Federation abilities
[*] Updated the fuel cost to upgrade to Harvesters
[*] Fixed a bug where the tooltip would not hide after fully upgrading a Federation ability
[*] Added more rewards to the pool of rewards available for destroying a Trade Convoy
[/list]

[b]Tech and Hymn Trees:[/b]
[list]
[*] Smoothed out the context area for the tooltips and made the context area smaller.  This should makes for a more precise browsing experience.
[*] Added that if you learn industry 3 when your mining guilds are already maxed you still gain +10 miner capacity
[/list]

[b]Events:[/b]
[list]
[*] Made events slightly less likely to spawn
[/list]

[b]Combat:[/b]
[list]
[*] Display hotkeys [1,2,3] for the active Carrier abilities/equipment
[*] Added hotkeys Q,W,E and the Numpad 1,2,3 to working hotkeys
[*] Added the ability to quickly redeploy your fleet in a new "Fleet Quick Deploy" panel
[/list]


Greetings from Hyper Empire!

It’s hard to believe that it’s only been a week since the launch of Hyper Empire! As a small two-man studio, this game means a lot to us and seeing people embrace the game over the last week has been amazing.

This is a passion project that we have been working on for the last 5 years, and we’ve spent the better part of the last year just focusing on polishing the game to give you the best experience possible.  We hope you can feel our love for this game.  No matter how much work is done to prepare for launch nothing is quite like the experience of being available to a wide audience.

It is part of the process of making a game that there will always be players who find fault and want something different.  To those players we want to say [b]"We hear you, we take your feedback seriously, and we are trying our best."[/b]

We did not anticipate there would be a demand for saving given the brevity of the game.  This was our mistake and we are sorry for the oversight.  In many ways this game is made by parents for parents.  We recognize that a new crisis can erupt at any moment to interrupt your gaming.  We are proud to announce that with this patch we have been able to add a simple Save and Continue feature.

The saving was put together through some very long nights, and to get it to you right away we were not able to thoroughly test every combination.  If you do find any bugs with the new save system please let us know in the Discussion Forum.

We are very grateful for each and every one of you that has played the game.  We have been working tirelessly to address all of your concerns big and small.  Keep the feedback coming.

We are still working on adding the ability to adjust your win conditions.  This existed in the game through the achievements, but we recognize this was not obvious enough and needs to be available to players sooner.  We both need to get some sleep and attend to our families, but this is our top priority for the next patch.  We will have a more intuitive and unified solution for this by the end of the month.


Still here?  Well download the update and get back to conquering the galaxy, and thank you again for an amazing first week!

Fair Weather Studios

notes.title: Patch 1.01
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416270/e5884c819947764b2dc652867776597600c16be4.png[/img]

Greetings from Hyper Empire!  Thank you to everyone who has played the game and shared your thoughts.  We want to make this the best experience possible for everyone.  Here are the quick fix patch notes:

[list]
[*] - Fixed a bug where the reward animation could get stuck on screen
[*] - Fixed resource icon for Hospital and Citadel
[*] - Added the Heresy as an enemy faction on Very Easy and Easy difficulties
[*] - Fixed a bug where the tool tip said Workshops capped at 4 when they actually cap at 6 built
[*] - The warning to build more Mining Guilds no longer appears if you have built the maximum number of mining guilds.
[*] - Added a warning window and tool tip when you are close to victory
[*] - Fixed a bug where Military Victory was not spawning achievements
[*] - Fixed a bug in the text when attacking a trade convoy
[*] - Fixed a bug where sometimes the wrong enemy carrier would display in the Sector Battle confirm window
[*] - Added reward chest animation when defeating a trade convoy
[*] - Increased the chance of a scan finding a trade convoy
[*] - lowered the Faith rewards for defeating a trade convoy
[*] - added help text to carrier information on main menu to tell you how to unlock the locked carriers
[*] - tweaked Empire ability animations and added several more animations to clarify what is happening
[*] - Added context tool tips to Empire abilities for more clarity
[/list]


We know that the option to continue a game when you get interrupted is important to some.  We are looking into what we can do about this but it will not be a quick fix.  We cannot currently commit to adding this feature, but we are investigating.  The game is designed as a roguelite, and the saving that occurs is your achievement progress between runs.  

We also have heard that some of you want the ability to customize the victory conditions.  This is already available in the game but was unlocked through achievements.  We are looking to move this feature to be automatically available after you win your first game instead.  This is also not a quick fix.


Please continue to share your thoughts and the glorious tales of your conquest.  We want this to be a great experience for you.

Good luck in your future games!
